native_function.pseudocode: glyph = glyph_ids[character_index]; DAT_00D3B5C0 = glyph; if glyph == 0 return 0; image = font_first + glyph - 1; metric_image = image; if image_count <= image metric_image = 0; accent = height(metric_image) - DAT_00D3B500; clamp accent to 0 when negative, character_index < 0x60, or index is 199/231; draw image at (x, y - 3 - accent); return width(metric_image).
native_function.known_boundary: The computed image ID is still sent to 0x0053E590 when outside the metric count; only height and width metric lookup falls back to image 0.
